commitments.detail: Enable automated pull request creation by the dependency-upgrade bot on a repository-by/repository basis.
Regularly review and address any issues in pull requests.
Ensure all repositories follow the final build, security, and operations checklist before enabling further automation.
Regularly review and merge pull requests within 7 days
Complete final build, security, and operations checklist before enabling further automation
Limit the bot to opening up to 5 pull requests at any time.
Require human approval before merging any pull requests generated by the bot.
